capabilities: Preview color swatches inline for HEX, RGB(A), and HSL(A) values
Colorize matching text when contrast stays readable
Toggle swatches, text colorization, and supported formats in settings
Show previews in both editor and reading view
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian shows color codes as plain text, so you cannot see what a HEX, RGB, or HSL value looks like without leaving the note.
summary: Inline color preview plugin that shows swatches for HEX, RGB(A), and HSL(A) values in notes, in both editing and reading view.
